tests: A switch: forwardRef with destructured defaults and rest props, a controlled-state hook, inner function handlers, computed class keys; used in a settings list of memo rows that get an inline callback per row, with a functional state update and a keyed list.
adaptation: Single file, vendored with types removed. React namespace calls became named imports because the harness retargets named imports only. clsx, KeyCode and useControlledState (@rc-component/util) are reduced local versions in the file. SettingRow and SettingsPanel are new: the panel holds the values in state, exposes the setter and its list element on globalThis, and counts enabled settings with countEnabled. SettingRow counts bump('Row').
